name: Madison River (Lower)
gaugeName: Madison bl Ennis Lake nr McAllister
blurb: Bozeman's classic summer float below Ennis Lake — plus Bear Trap Canyon if you want real whitewater.

sections.notes: Bear Trap Canyon. Not a tube float. Scout Kitchen Sink. Permits/use limits can apply — check BLM/FWP.
The beer-can hatch. Watch for shallow gravel bars in late summer.
Quieter Lower Madison float. Use the designated Greycliff access; shoreline land is not automatically open for stopping.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: Montana FWP Fishing Access Site Guide (2017), pp. 49 and 51

putIn.name: Black's Ford
putIn.sourceLocation: Printed page 51, Lower Madison: Black’s Ford

distanceEvidence.note: About 4 miles between the named access sites, based on FWP’s rounded river miles 24 and 20. The former 9-mile value was incorrect. Whole-mile guide markers are approximate; channels and the specific landing can change the distance.
